title: Git submodule gitlink, nested-repository, and checkout-visibility tribunal
hypothesis: A read-only family-compatible classifier can distinguish ordinary directories, declared gitlinks, deinitialized submodules, and undeclared nested repositories so that manifest and privacy claims cannot silently skip an opaque repository boundary.
falsifier_or_gate: Exercise ordinary trees, mode-160000 entries, declared and undeclared nested repositories, missing worktrees, malicious paths, and network-required states; ambiguous or out-of-root cases must fail closed without fetching.
evidence_class: bounded structural, proxy, open-gap, or exact-gate software evidence
boundary: Acceptance is confined to the frozen software evidence class and cannot promote empirical, participant, identity, authority, privacy, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.
